tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Return one curated record by its stable id (from search_guidance): provider, canonical source URL, applicability, limitations, labels, the date the source was verified, its snapshot hash and the ledger commit. Unknown ids return an error; nothing is fetched from the web.

tools.name: check_source_freshness
tools.description: Fetch one allowlisted official documentation page from the curated registry and compare its normalized text with the verified snapshot. findings.detail: Description of "check_source_freshness" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
